PACK_P.note: the pack lead. THE SWITCH IS THE GAUGE: Q2 is the discharge FET and the BQ4050 drives its gate on DSG_G, so the pack terminal is live only while the gauge allows it, which is the first stage of the energy chain

CELL4.note: the top cell node from the block strip
CELL4.always_on_why: the cell block itself: there is nothing upstream of it to switch, which is why everything downstream is protected rather than enabled

FUSED.always_on_why: the cell node after the 25 A blade: a fuse is protection and not a switch

PACK_N.basis: the pack negative, one 2 mOhm shunt away from GND: 50 mV at the 25 A the counter is scaled for, which is a reference and not a voltage a part has to withstand

GND.basis: the board's reference, so a part between a live net and ground is judged against the live net rather than reported as sitting on an undeclared one
